literal_meaning: যককে আগলানো (yak-like thing to lock or guard tightly)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে যক আগলানোর মতো তার সম্পত্তি রক্ষা করে।
এই অবস্থায় যক আগলানো কোনো কাজে আসবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He guards his property like locking a yak, being extremely stingy.
Being miserly like locking the yak won't help in this situation.
note: This idiom appears to be a lesser-known or regional expression; 'যক' may refer to a mythical or animalistic element implying tight guarding, rooted in folk imagery.
